title: Flow Check & Action Registry
description: Declarative registry of policy checks and actions available to flow definitions. Used for flow validation at save time and by UI tooling.

checks.description: Policy check definitions keyed by check name.

actions.description: Action definitions keyed by action name.

additionalProperties.description: Human-readable description of when this outcome is returned.

outcomes.description: Possible outcome strings this check can return, with descriptions.

requires.description: Flow state fields that must be populated before this check runs (e.g. 'user', 'identifier').

sets.description: Flow state fields this check populates on success (e.g. 'user', 'sso_identity').

additionalProperties.description: Human-readable description of when this outcome is returned.

outcomes.description: Possible outcome strings this action can return, with descriptions.

requires.description: Flow state fields that must be populated before this action runs.

sets.description: Flow state fields this action populates on success.

idempotent.description: Whether this action is safe to retry.
